app.name: Acceptance Portal
app.tagline: AI-assisted photo acceptance for telecom installations

download.title: Mobile app
download.description: Install the technician app on Android to capture and upload acceptance photos.
download.sideload: On the phone, allow “Install unknown apps” for your browser, then open the downloaded file.

review.savingDescription: The queue will refresh when they are stored.
review.emptyDescription: No photos are waiting for review with these filters. New uploads appear here automatically.
review.alreadyDecided: Someone else already decided this photo. It was removed from your queue.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Single keys work anywhere on this screen, in any keyboard layout (Arabic too).

actions.agree: Agree with the AI and move on
actions.addSnag: Add a snag the AI missed

viewer.drawHint: Drag on the photo to mark where the snag is (optional). Esc to skip.

ai.categoryMismatch: The AI thinks this is not the expected category

snags.title: Snags
snags.markBox: Mark the area on the photo

picker.title: Add a snag
picker.description: Search in Arabic or English. Snags for this category are listed first.
picker.none: No snag matches. Try other words.

decision.title: Final decision
decision.acceptHint: Photo is approved, AI snags are dismissed
decision.rejectHint: Technician must fix the snags and re-shoot
decision.willDismiss: {n} AI snag(s) will be dismissed as wrong

planError.noAi: There is no AI result to agree with. Use Reject / Override.
planError.uncertain: The AI was uncertain. Choose Accept or Reject yourself.
planError.acceptWithSnags: The AI accepted but listed snags. Use Reject / Override to resolve them.
planError.hasEdits: You have staged changes. Submit them instead of agreeing.
planError.acceptWithAdded: You cannot accept a photo while adding snags.
planError.rejectNeedsSnag: A rejected photo needs at least one snag so the technician knows what to fix. Press S to add one.
planError.reasonRequired: Write a short reason for overriding the AI.

snagTracker.title: Snag tracker
snagTracker.description: Every snag from open to fixed to verified.
snagTracker.emptyHint: Change the filters, or enjoy a clean site.
snagTracker.reopenDescription: The fix was not good enough. The technician will see your reason.

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: Exchanges and rooms with installed equipment.

progress.title: Progress per category
progress.emptyHint: Progress appears when technicians upload photos.

accuracy.title: AI accuracy
accuracy.description: How often reviewers agree with the AI, per category, against the autonomy thresholds.
accuracy.phaseNote: Phase 1: every photo is reviewed by a human. These numbers decide when a category may be released to automatic acceptance.
accuracy.emptyHint: Agreement appears after reviewers decide photos that the AI analysed.

kpi.agreementHint: Reviewer agreed with verdict and snags

byCategory.title: Agreement by category
byCategory.description: Lowest first. The second bar is the agreement the autonomy policy requires.

trend.description: Weekly agreement rate and the number of photos behind it.
trend.aria: Line chart of weekly agreement with bars for weekly volume

table.title: Autonomy readiness
table.description: A category qualifies when it has enough samples and meets the agreement threshold.
